title: Your Recovery Handoff
subtitle: Create a concise summary for your next phase of recovery.
description: This summary records what you understand, what you can manage, what remains difficult, and what you want to discuss. Completing it does not replace clinical assessment.

sections.title: Understanding and confidence
sections.description: Identify what is clear and what may need review.

fields.label: How confident are you managing an expected difficult recovery day?
Which ideas now make sense to you?
options: Pain is real and influenced by many kinds of information
Stress, sleep, food, hydration, and support can affect recovery participation
Hands-on care may create an opportunity that movement can build on
Pacing should support progression rather than permanent avoidance
Thoughts and emotions can influence actions without making pain imaginary
I can use context to help decide whether to continue, modify, or seek support
Recovery can fluctuate without all progress being lost

fields.label: Which idea remains unclear or difficult to apply?
fields.placeholder: A concept, strategy, or situation you want reviewed...

sections.title: Current recovery picture
sections.description: Focus on the barrier and goal most relevant now.

fields.label: My main recovery barrier right now is:
fields.placeholder: Symptoms, confidence, sleep, stress, work, time, uncertainty, support, or something else...

fields.label: The meaningful activity or goal I am working toward is:
fields.placeholder: What are you trying to return to or build?

fields.label: Evidence that I am moving forward includes:
fields.placeholder: Function, confidence, participation, recovery time, understanding, or another useful change...

sections.title: My working plan
sections.description: Summarize the decisions you want available on a difficult day.

fields.label: When symptoms increase, my first steps are:
The tools that fit me best are:
fields.placeholder: Movement, pacing, task changes, sleep support, regulation, social support, treatment, or other strategies...

fields.label: I will seek professional support when:
fields.placeholder: New or concerning symptoms, worsening function, uncertainty, stalled progress, significant distress...

sections.title: Next conversation
sections.description: Use this to make the next appointment more focused.

fields.label: My main question for my practitioner is:
fields.placeholder: What do you most need clarified or decided?

fields.label: What may need review?
options: No clinical review needed right now

fields.label: My next manageable action:
fields.placeholder: One specific action to carry forward...

successMessage: Your seven-week recovery handoff is complete. Use it to guide the next phase and your next clinical conversation.
